svg.aria-label: Keeping watch on AI. A burst chart of the SafeAI.watch record: 95 dated, sourced entries from Mar 2023 to Oct 2026, one dot each: 27 warnings, 26 incidents, 22 governance, 20 research. Distance from the centre is the entry's date; dashed rings mark January 1. The record is a selection, so density shows what it covers, not how often things happen.

svg.text: A dated record of AI safety and security
research, incidents, warnings, and policy. Each
entry links its original source and separates
what happened from what remains uncertain.
ONE DOT PER ENTRY · FARTHER OUT = NEWER
A SELECTION · DENSITY SHOWS COVERAGE, NOT FREQUENCY
